title: Csv record parse
statement: Parse a single ASCII CSV record containing no CR/LF. Fields are comma separated. A quoted field begins with double quote, escapes a quote as doubled quotes, and must close immediately before comma/end. Quotes inside unquoted fields are invalid. Return accepted(value) holding the list of decoded field strings (empty record is one empty field), or rejected(malformed).
constraints: All text is ASCII; unless a narrower task bound is stated, each input string has at most 1000 characters.
Preserve the exact declared public types and solve signature. Helpers are allowed.
No input/output, exception throwing, panic, tests, or static diagnostic suppression in the submitted source.

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

enum TextError:
    empty
    malformed
    range
enum TextOutcome:
    accepted(value: list[string])
    rejected(error: TextError)
function solve(text: string) returns TextOutcome
